stemMd: Which explanation is consistent with both the enzyme information and Experiment2?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The amount of gas must equal the extract volume.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Heating created more active enzyme than was present initially.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Heating reduced the activity of a protein catalyst, and fresh extract supplied additional active catalyst

options.label: D
options.textMd: Cooling necessarily restored all original enzyme activity.

explanationMd: Protein structural changes can reduce catalytic activity. The lower heated result and partial recovery with fresh extract are consistent with this explanation, without proving that only one substance is involved.

distractorRationale.d: The heated-and-cooled sample remained at2mL gas versus13mL untreated.
distractorRationale.b: Heated extract produced less gas than untreated extract.
distractorRationale.a: The measured values are not equal.
